name: Soul Harvester: Parasite Protocol
detailed_description:
[FRAGMENT PROTOCOL – AUTHORIZED ACCESS]

Welcome to subsystem SCP-Δ19.

You are here because you've been designated as a collector of fragmented souls.

You don't need to remember who you are. You only need to obey.

Soul Harvester: Fragment Protocol is a hidden chapter in the TopSecret universe, an immersive narrative experience where you explore corrupted remnants of failed digital identities within Project Cipher: a hellish system designed to simulate eternal damnation.

Your task is simple: recover consciousness fragments, reassemble them, and send them into the cycle. But each file echoes something familiar. The glitches speak. And the fragments… remember you.

Key Features:

  • Access a corrupted subsystem of the TopSecret universe, full of errors, failed protocols, and hidden files.

  • Psychological and philosophical narrative: identity, memory, guilt, and reconstruction.

  • Multiple endings that alter the outcome of the Protocol.

  • Collect, analyze, and decide with no ability to go back.

  • Broken system interface, 2D glitch-hell aesthetic.

  • You're not playing. You're executing an order.
